summary: Marex Group Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing that Robert Pickering stepped down from the board on October 6, 2026, having completed his appointed three-year term as Chair. The board appointed existing director John Pietrowicz, who joined in April 2024 and chairs the M&A Committee, as the new Chair. Pickering will assist with the transition. No price, stake, premium or advisory terms are stated. The change is a planned, term-driven succession rather than an abrupt forced departure, and no regulatory clock or overhang applies; watch for interim governance continuity and any strategic shift in M&A posture.
